name: rastin-claude-code
displayName: Rastin — Persian RTL for Claude Code
description: IranYekanX face and per-message RTL/LTR direction for Claude Code's chat in VS Code. Code and tool rows stay LTR.

commands.title: Rastin: Repair after Claude Code update

rastin.enabled.description: Apply the Rastin font and direction rules to Claude Code.

enumDescriptions: Regular (the face shipped in the bundle).
Medium; synthesized from Regular on the bundled face.
Semibold; synthesized from Regular on the bundled face.
Bold (the face shipped in the bundle).
rastin.fontWeight.description: Prose font weight for Claude Code chat and composer.

rastin.fontFamily.description: Font family to use for chat prose, e.g. "Vazirmatn". It must already be installed on this machine. Leave empty to use the bundled IranYekanX.

rastin.fontFile.description: Absolute path to a .woff2/.woff/.ttf/.otf file to use as the chat face, for fonts that are not installed. Copied into Claude Code's webview next to the bundled faces.

rastin.fontSize.description: Chat font size in px, overriding Claude Code's own size. 0 keeps Claude Code's setting.

rastin.lineHeight.description: Line height for Claude Code chat prose and composer.

rastin.codeFontFamily.description: Font family for code blocks and inline code. Leave empty to follow the VS Code editor font.

enumDescriptions: Use the colors of the current VS Code theme.
Use Claude's warm ivory/slate palette, in the light or dark variant that matches VS Code.
